title: Scene Composition Format (SCF) v1.3
description: Portable, declarative specification for layered scene compositions with spray accents, CSS sprays, geometric shapes, subject images, inline SVGs, and text layers.

$schema.description: Format version identifier. Must be scene-composition/1.3.

BlobCompact.description: Compact blob: [cx, cy, rx, ry, color?, opacity?]

background.description: CSS background — solid color, gradient, or image.

subject.description: Deprecated. Single subject for 1.0 backward compatibility.

ContentAnchor.description: Declares how an ordered array of render-time content layers is bound into this template. Content items are merged with `defaults[kind]` and auto-assigned zIndex from `zStart` + i*`zStep`. See spec §11.

zStart.description: zIndex of the first content layer.

zStep.description: zIndex increment per content layer. Leaves gaps for template-authored layers to interleave.

defaults.description: Per-kind default props applied to content items before the item's own fields. Enforces consistent styling across all content payloads.

backdropFilter.description: CSS backdrop-filter — frosts the content BEHIND the layer (e.g., 'blur(12px) saturate(1.4)'). Renderer emits both unprefixed and -webkit- prefixed variants.

objectPosition.description: CSS object-position. Shifts the focal point inside the crop — e.g. 'center 30%' pulls the subject down in a cover-mode frame.

hideBelow.description: CSS length (e.g. '640px'). Hide this layer when the composition container's width is below the threshold. See spec §3.4.

decorative.description: Overrides the per-kind decorative heuristic. True = always hidden in hero flow mode; false = always treated as content. See spec §3.4.

content.description: Plain text content. Use \n for line breaks.

textAlign.description: Defaults to the value of `align` if omitted.

textShadow.description: CSS text-shadow (e.g., '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'). Unlike drop-shadow via filter, text-shadow does NOT create a new stacking context, so it composes correctly with mixBlendMode. Prefer this over filter: drop-shadow() for shadowing text.

align.description: Horizontal positioning sugar. Overridden by explicit `left`/`right`.

vAlign.description: Vertical positioning sugar. Overridden by explicit `top`/`bottom`.

seed.description: PRNG seed for splatter mode (ignored by other modes).

content.description: SVG markup. Either a complete <svg>…</svg> element (rendered as-is) or a bare fragment (e.g. <path>, <g>) that the renderer auto-wraps using the layer's viewBox.

viewBox.description: Coordinate space for fragment content. Ignored when `content` is a complete <svg>.

color.description: CSS color applied to the wrapper. Inherited by fill="currentColor" / stroke="currentColor" inside the markup. Accepts CSS variables.

decorative.description: Overrides the per-kind decorative heuristic. True = always hidden in hero flow mode; false = always treated as content. See spec §3.4.

Separator.description: Flow-mode-only layer. Renders nothing in desktop mode; becomes a visible horizontal rule in hero flow mode (spec §3.4.3). Participates in the z-index stack like any other layer. See spec §10.

gap.description: Vertical space contributed in flow mode. Normal ≈ 0.5rem extra margin; large ≈ 1.5rem extra margin.

label.description: Optional centered label rendered between the rule segments.

color.description: Rule and label color. Inherits container color by default.

thickness.description: CSS length for the rule. Set to '0' for invisible gap only.
